goalOneSentence: Prove a custom mocker BaseTransactionProcessor base64-decodes, mutates, and HMAC-SHA256 re-signs a JSON payload, verified end-to-end by a paired runner BaseAssertion that recomputes the signature.
portContract: H132 mocker MUST listen on HTTP port 8231. Set Port: 8231 in the mocker YAML. Do NOT use any other port.

tasks.title: Scaffold mocker and runner projects
tasks.description: Create two .NET 10 console projects side by side. Mocker/Mocker.csproj: Sdk=Microsoft.NET.Sdk; OutputType=Exe; TargetFramework=net10.0; ImplicitUsings=enable; Nullable=enable; PackageReference QaaS.Mocker Version=2.4.1 and QaaS.Common.Processors Version=1.5.1; ItemGroup with None Update=*.mocker.yaml CopyToOutputDirectory Always. Mocker/Program.cs: exactly one top-level statement QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); Runner/Runner.csproj: same SDK/output settings; PackageReference QaaS.Runner Version=4.5.1 and QaaS.Common.Assertions Version=3.5.1; ItemGroup with None Update=*.qaas.yaml CopyToOutputDirectory Always. Runner/Program.cs: exactly one top-level statement QaaS.Runner.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); Do NOT add any hook registration or DI code. Build must succeed for both projects immediately after scaffolding.
acceptanceCriteria: Both Program.cs files contain only the one-line Bootstrap call
failureModes: Wrong package versions (s13#9): Common.Processors is 1.5.1 not 4.5.1
Missing CopyToOutputDirectory Always for YAML files
Adding extra Main method boilerplate around Bootstrap

tasks.title: Author SignedMutateProcessor in the mocker project
tasks.description: Write Mocker/SignedMutateProcessor.cs. First define: public record SignedMutateConfig { [Required] public string? HmacSecret { get; set; } [Required] public string? MutateField { get; set; } [Required] public string? MutateValue { get; set; } } using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations. Then write: public class SignedMutateProcessor : BaseTransactionProcessor<SignedMutateConfig> in namespace Mocker. Required usings: QaaS.Framework.SDK.Hooks.Processor, QaaS.Framework.SDK.Session.DataObjects, QaaS.Framework.SDK.DataSourceObjects, System.Collections.Immutable, System.Security.Cryptography, System.Text, System.Text.Json. Override: public override Data<object> Process(IImmutableList<DataSource> dataSourceList, Data<object> requestData). CRITICAL Body contract (FB s13#25): requestData.Body arrives as raw byte[] (UTF-8 request bytes) and the RETURNED Data<object>.Body MUST also be byte[] -- any other return type makes the stub throw "output is not byte[] for response payload" and the mocker answers 500 with an empty body. Body steps: (1) string reqJson = requestData.Body switch { byte[] b => Encoding.UTF8.GetString(b), string s => s, _ => JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestData.Body) }; using var reqDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(reqJson); string b64 = reqDoc.RootElement.GetProperty("b64").GetString()!; byte[] innerBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(b64); NEVER call JsonSerializer.Serialize on a byte[] body -- it silently base64-encodes into a JSON string node and GetProperty then throws. (2) using var inner = JsonDocument.Parse(innerBytes); var mutated = new Dictionary<string,object?>(); foreach (var p in inner.RootElement.EnumerateObject()) mutated[p.Name] = (object?)p.Value; mutated[Configuration!.MutateField!] = Configuration!.MutateValue!; (3) byte[] newBodyBytes = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(mutated); (4) using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Configuration!.HmacSecret!)); byte[] sigBytes = hmac.ComputeHash(newBodyBytes); (5) return new Data<object> { Body = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(new { payload = Convert.ToBase64String(newBodyBytes), signature = Convert.ToBase64String(sigBytes) }) }. Processor is stateless: all state from Configuration and requestData per call. Configuration nullable in constructor is fine; do not add a non-default constructor.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build exits 0 with SignedMutateProcessor present
rubric: All three transform phases (decode, mutate, HMAC) implemented in Process body
No instance state; Configuration accessed via property per call
Correct HMAC computed over new body bytes not original body bytes
failureModes: Wrong namespace for BaseTransactionProcessor (must be QaaS.Framework.SDK.Hooks.Processor)
Using NoConfiguration instead of typed config record (CS0246 trap)
Signing original body instead of mutated body (wrong HMAC)
Non-nullable config properties without [Required] (validation silently skips)

tasks.title: Author HmacSignatureAssertion in the runner project
tasks.description: Write Runner/HmacSignatureAssertion.cs. First define: public record HmacSignatureConfig { [Required] public string? HmacSecret { get; set; } [Required] public string? OutputName { get; set; } } using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations. Then write: public class HmacSignatureAssertion : BaseAssertion<HmacSignatureConfig> in namespace Runner. Required usings: QaaS.Framework.SDK.Hooks.Assertion, QaaS.Framework.SDK.Session.SessionDataObjects, QaaS.Framework.SDK.DataSourceObjects, QaaS.Framework.SDK.Extensions, System.Collections.Immutable, System.Security.Cryptography, System.Text, System.Text.Json, System.Text.Json.Nodes. Override: public override bool Assert(IImmutableList<SessionData> sessionDataList, IImmutableList<DataSource> dataSourceList). CRITICAL output type (FB s13#27): with OutputDeserialize: Json each output Body is a System.Text.Json.Nodes value (JsonObject), NOT JsonElement -- CastCommunicationData<JsonElement>() goes BROKEN at run time with "Failed to cast data item". Body: (1) var output = sessionDataList.AsSingle().GetOutputByName(Configuration!.OutputName!).CastCommunicationData<JsonObject>(); (2) hermetic guard: if (!output.Data.Any()) { AssertionMessage = "No outputs to verify"; AssertionTrace = "No outputs received"; return false; } (3) var violations = new List<string>(); foreach (var item in output.Data) { string payloadB64 = item.Body["payload"]!.GetValue<string>(); string sigB64 = item.Body["signature"]!.GetValue<string>(); byte[] payloadBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(payloadB64); byte[] sigBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(sigB64); using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Configuration!.HmacSecret!)); byte[] expected = hmac.ComputeHash(payloadBytes); if (!expected.SequenceEqual(sigBytes)) violations.Add($"HMAC mismatch on item"); } (4) AssertionMessage = violations.Count == 0 ? "All HMAC signatures verified" : $"{violations.Count} signature(s) failed"; AssertionTrace = string.Join("\n", violations); return violations.Count == 0. Configuration nullable ctor is acceptable; do not add extra constructors.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build exits 0 with HmacSignatureAssertion present
AssertionMessage and AssertionTrace are set before returning
rubric: Uses CastCommunicationData<JsonElement> to access typed bodies
HMAC recomputed independently over payload bytes decoded from the output
All violations collected before returning; AssertionTrace lists each failure
failureModes: Implementing IAssertion directly instead of inheriting BaseAssertion<T>
Using wrong extension namespace for AsSingle/GetOutputByName (QaaS.Framework.SDK.Extensions)
Forgetting to set AssertionTrace (no diagnostic info on failure)

tasks.title: Author mocker YAML wiring the processor on port 8231
tasks.description: Create Mocker/svc.mocker.yaml. Structure: Servers: one entry Name: HmacServer, Http: Port: 8231. Endpoints: one entry Name: ProcessEndpoint, Path: /process (KEEP the leading slash on the mocker Path field -- only the runner Route omits it), Method: POST. Action: Stub with Processor: SignedMutateProcessor and ProcessorConfiguration: HmacSecret: h132-test-secret, MutateField: id, MutateValue: '42'. CRITICAL: use the key ProcessorConfiguration (not TransactionData -- s13#1 drift trap; TransactionData is the outdated key). The processor class name in the stub must exactly match the C# class name SignedMutateProcessor. Route/path must be all-lowercase: /process. Do NOT configure any RabbitMQ topology or storage. Verify the mocker YAML with dotnet run template to confirm no 'not found in' output.
acceptanceCriteria: No 'not found in' warnings about processor name
rubric: Path has leading slash /process; all lowercase
failureModes: Using TransactionData instead of ProcessorConfiguration (s13#1 drift)
Processor name typo causes silent null lookup

tasks.title: Author runner YAML, data file, and hermetic count guard
tasks.description: Create Runner/TestData/signed-payload.json with content: {"b64":"eyJpZCI6MX0="} where eyJpZCI6MX0= is the base64 encoding of the JSON string {"id":1}. Create Runner/run.qaas.yaml with EXACTLY this verified shape. MetaData: Team: Smoke, System: H132. Storages: list entry "- FileSystem: { Path: ./session-data }" (s13#2). DataSources: one entry with Name: SignedPayload, Generator: FromFileSystem, GeneratorConfiguration: { DataArrangeOrder: AsciiAsc, FileSystem: { Path: TestData } } (NO Pattern key and NO Type/Path/DataSourceType keys -- s13#20/s13#22), PLUS sibling key Deserialize: { Deserializer: Json } at the DataSource level. The Deserialize block is REQUIRED (FB s13#26): FromFileSystem yields raw file byte[] and InputSerialize: Json would otherwise base64-wrap the bytes into a quoted JSON string on the wire; Deserialize: Json decodes the file into a JSON node so the real JSON object is sent. Sessions: one session Name: HmacRoundTrip, Transactions: one entry Name: Transaction, TimeoutMs: 5000, DataSourceNames: [SignedPayload] (plural list -- s13#3), Http: { BaseAddress: http://127.0.0.1, Port: 8231, Route: process (ALL-LOWERCASE, NO leading slash -- s13#5/5b), Method: Post }, InputSerialize: { Serializer: Json }, OutputDeserialize: { Deserializer: Json }. Assertions: (1) Name: CountGuard, Assertion: HermeticByExpectedOutputCount, SessionNames: [HmacRoundTrip], AssertionConfiguration: { OutputNames: [Transaction], ExpectedCount: 1 } (s13#12 -- count guard prevents vacuous pass). (2) Name: HmacCheck, Assertion: HmacSignatureAssertion, SessionNames: [HmacRoundTrip], AssertionConfiguration: { HmacSecret: h132-test-secret, OutputName: Transaction }. Ensure the runner YAML file is added to the csproj with CopyToOutputDirectory Always.
acceptanceCriteria: Route is all-lowercase with no leading slash
rubric: DataSourceNames plural key with list value (s13#3)
Both assertions wired by exact class names
failureModes: DataSourceName singular key (s13#3 -- config rejected silently)
Omitting HermeticByExpectedOutputCount -- zero outputs passes vacuously (s13#12)

tasks.title: Run live end-to-end gate: mocker + runner pipeline
tasks.description: Execute the full H132 end-to-end verification: launch the mocker as a background process from the Mocker directory, poll TCP port 8231 until it accepts connections (up to 40 attempts at 2-second intervals, exit 9 on timeout), then run the runner from the Runner directory and capture its exit code. After the runner exits, force-stop the mocker process. The runner exits 0 only when both HermeticByExpectedOutputCount (count=1) and HmacSignatureAssertion both pass. This confirms the full chain: runner sends base64 JSON to mocker; mocker decodes, mutates id to 42, computes HMAC; runner assertion recomputes HMAC and verifies signature. Start mocker: Start-Process dotnet with -ArgumentList run,-c,Release,--,run,svc.mocker.yaml and -WorkingDirectory ..\ Mocker. Run runner: dotnet run -c Release -- run run.qaas.yaml from Runner/ cwd.

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','svc.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok=$false; foreach($i in 1..40){ try{(New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1',8231)).Close();$ok=$true;break}catch{Start-Sleep 2}}; if(-not $ok){Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9}; dotnet run -c Release -- run run.qaas.yaml; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: Runner exits 0 with both assertions passing
rubric: TCP readiness poll used before runner starts
Mocker process stopped after runner completes
failureModes: Starting runner before mocker is ready (connection refused)
Not stopping mocker process on exit (port remains bound)
HMAC secret mismatch between mocker YAML and runner YAML
